fact.prompt: Explain in three sentences why the sky is blue.
fact.content: Sunlight contains all colors of light, but air molecules scatter the shorter blue wavelengths much more strongly than the longer red ones. This scattered blue light bounces around the sky in all directions, so it reaches your eyes from every part of the sky rather than just from the sun. That's why you see a blue sky instead of a white or red one.
